name: Monroe Gas Storage Laterals
monitor_reason: length: the 22.9 mi figure is unsourced beyond one EIA release and is probably a duplicated project-level figure
researcher_notes: No existing GEM row matches. The only Monroe row in the roster is P0235 in Ohio, which is unrelated. Monroe Gas Storage Company LLC (Mississippi, Monroe County) filed under FERC docket CP07-406 in June 2007. The Federal Register notice from July 11, 2007 confirms the storage project and its connections to Texas Eastern and Tennessee Gas Pipeline, but it states no lateral length. EIA lists two completed laterals, the Texas Eastern lateral (completed 2008) and the Tennessee Gas lateral (completed 2009), each at 22.9 miles, 24 inch, 465 million cubic feet per day. 465 is the whole storage project's deliverability, so the same figures look copied onto both rows. No independent source for either length was found. Both lines are already built, so there is no pending step. Not staged as new rows because a sourced length of at least 25 km for new pipe is not established. If a FERC order or the operator confirms about 22.9 mi per lateral, that is 36.9 km each and would qualify as two operating rows. Recheck against the FERC certificate order for CP07-406.
